excerpt: How to Claim 15 CRS Points for a Canadian Sibling in Express Entry Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Under Canada’s Express Entry Comprehensive Ranking System (CRS), you can receive 15 additional CRS points if you or your accompanying spouse/common-law partner have a brother or sister living in Canada who is a Canadian citizen or permanent resident. While the rule sounds simple, siblings points in express entry are one of the most commonly misclaimed CRS factors. Many applications are refused or reassessed because applicants misunderstand who qualifies as a sibling
